files.s: This file defines H-spaces mainly following the approach proposed by Serre in his paper *Homologie singulière des espaces fibrés*. The idea beneath `H-spaces` is that they are topological spaces with a binary operation `⋀ : X → X → X` that is a homotopy-theoretic weakening of an operation that would make `X` into a topological monoid.

h.d: Every topological group `G` is an `H-space` using its operation `* : G → G → G` (this is already true if `G` has an instance of a `MulOneClass` and `ContinuousMul`);

files.s: We define the `n`th homotopy group at `x : X`, `π_n X x`, as the equivalence classes of functions from the `n`-dimensional cube to the topological space `X` that send the boundary to the base point `x`, up to homotopic equivalence. Note that such functions are generalized loops `GenLoop (Fin n) x`; in particular `GenLoop (Fin 1) x ≃ Path x x`.
